symptom: `mxcli check --references` passed `Image: 'Atlas_Core.Content.mendix'` for the stored image `Mendix` (and `Atlas_Core.content.Mendix`, `atlas_core.Content.Mendix`); mx then reported CE1613 "The selected image '…' no longer exists" for each. The miss hint `it holds: mendix` printed the name lower-cased, so copying it from the message produced the CE1613
cause: imageRefErrors / buildImageQualifiedNames (and the script context's created collections) keyed every image and collection lower-cased on the unmeasured assumption, pinned by two tests, that Mendix resolves names case-insensitively
insight: Measure case-sensitivity per part before encoding it: one blank-app run with four pages (exact, wrong image case, wrong collection case, wrong module case) through `docker check --no-update-widgets` settled it — CE1613 on all three, clean on the exact one. Two tests asserted the opposite ("Mendix resolves names case-insensitively, and so must this") with no measurement behind them; they were inverted, not deleted. A case-only miss names the stored spelling instead of the generic hint, and the hint lists names as stored. The icon reference check (iconIndex) was already exact. Found while verifying ako/mxcli#1503
